notes: Deltas are off - on per round (positive = on faster); noise = half range of the paired deltas. S2/S3 first_us = first draft step after the verify pass, later_us = mean of the other steps; refill_us = first - later. Window: arena start, clamped to the device window max; hitRatio auto = min(1, limit / window). PDL knob also applies to the verify graph. Verify uses batch-1 GEMV as a bandwidth proxy. Arena order is state, kv, scratch, norms, head, matrices (a clamped window drops matrices first); not in the arena: attention split scratch (__device__ g_attn_* in toy_ops.cu); x.copy_(x0) memcpy node; int8 head logits (allocated by int8_gemv). S1 off is naturally L2-resident for D <= L2 (row flag d_le_l2): S1 deltas near 0 there are expected, S2/S3 first_us is the residency test. refill_us is the survival metric; S1 (burst events) and S2 (event per graph) step times are not compared. Rows have persist_limit_bytes (driver readback), persist_limit_req_bytes, window_ok and kernel_nodes; floor_us = kernel_nodes * graph_node_gap_us (lower bound of the launch floor, needs calibration), floor_frac = floor_us / step_us: a step made of 100+ small kernels can gain only a few % even when fully resident. verify_gbps counts unique weight bytes. With --verify-cols kp1 the projection baseline is a 1-column verify (config verify1_us).
